authorization.operation_class: governed design-history recovery, classification, and project-definition preparation

status_summary: Recovered design intent was classified and published as candidate project-definition documentation on a dedicated review branch; implementation and dependency selection remained out of scope.
recovered_design_intent: blAIne AV Studio is a governed multimedia creation and production environment integrating visual rendering and animation with first-class audio under a shared project and timeline model.
Visual, audio, asset, scene, project, timeline, editor, preview/export, AI-assistance, and governance responsibilities belong in one coherent product definition.
Projects, scenes, effects, and controllable parameters are intended to be data-driven so editor and AI tooling can operate through bounded deterministic abstractions.
AI assistance directs structured project state and engine parameters rather than directly owning frame rendering.
Steam Deck is the primary development machine; other named platforms remain candidate compute, test, preview, client, export, or deployment contexts.
Studio and reusable engine/runtime responsibilities may be separated where useful, with GACP providing durable approved-artifact and inter-agent continuity.
proposed_structures: A responsibility-based subsystem classification covering core/runtime, rendering, animation, particles, shaders/materials/effects, project/scene data, assets, audio, master timeline, studio UI, target runtimes, export, AI assistance, and governance integration.
A candidate dependency direction in which structured project state and shared time feed deterministic runtime systems while editor and AI tools modify bounded abstractions.
A non-binding audio-visual timeline vocabulary including project, master timeline, timed item, optional track or lane, parameter automation, asset reference, and evaluation result.
A platform-role classification separating development, compute/test, preview/runtime, broadcast integration, packaged application, and rendered output contexts.
A gated roadmap from owner acceptance through decision framing, a separately authorized minimal proof, subsystem increments, and later productization.
A candidate authority-state vocabulary distinguishing continuity evidence, candidate definition, accepted definition, implementation authorization, implemented evidence, and substantive acceptance.
